understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level, completing the current BP35 level and continuing until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each level provides 2 attempts with up to 50 turns per attempt. MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift the player horizontally, while gravity causes vertical movement. CLICK targets a tile, potentially removing clickable tiles or affecting movement. Landing on a spike ends the attempt and restarts the level. Undo can reverse a prior action when available.
